translations.web: For this reason, God gave them up to vile passions. For their women changed the natural function into that which is against nature.
translations.bsb: For this reason God gave them over to dishonorable passions. Even their women exchanged natural relations for unnatural ones.
translations.kjv: For this cause God gave them up unto vile affections: for even their women did change the natural use into that which is against nature:
